column1: # RELOCATIONS INTO go1.26.9 -- the rows whose tests moved into this release, one `source<TAB>target` per
# line (a source that fanned out appears once per target). -Hop reads it for each row's Receives: PROVENANCE,
# never an expectation. Every target is in population-go1.26.9.txt.
# A FOLDED HOP: measured against the OUTGOING release, go1.24.13, not against go1.25.14 (runbook H3, AMENDED
# 2026-10-13). population-go1.24.13.txt -> population-go1.26.9.txt is 230 -> 242: 17 added rows, 5 removed.
# DERIVED BY BODY (C2, 2026-10-14), not by name: every top-level Test/Benchmark/Fuzz/Example function of the 17
# ADDED and 5 REMOVED rows was matched against every std _test.go of the other release (GOROOTs go1.24.13 and
# go1.26.9 from the module proxy; cmd, vendor and testdata excluded; the ratio is difflib's over the printed
# function). An arc needs the test bodies to have LEFT the source and ARRIVED at the target:
#   runtime/internal/wasitest -> internal/runtime/wasitest: TestNonblock 0.98, TestTCPEcho 0.98; both files 0.99.
#   internal/trace/internal/oldtrace -> internal/trace/internal/tracev1: parser_test.go 1.00, 3 of 3 tests at 1.00.
#   go/ast/internal/tests -> go/ast: TestSortImportsUpdatesFileImportsField, 1.00, in go/ast/import_test.go; the
#     source directory is gone. NOT a true removal (as at 1.25.14).
#   strconv -> internal/strconv: PARTIAL, the source row survives. 61 of internal/strconv's test functions match
#     strconv's at 1.24.13 (most at 1.00); 37 of them LEFT strconv (116 -> 77 functions), the other 24 are in both.
#     Its fixture testdata/testfp.txt moved with them.
#   runtime -> internal/strconv: PARTIAL, the source row survives. TestAtoi left runtime/string_test.go and is
#     internal/strconv's TestAtoi at 0.84 (0.74 against strconv's own). TestAtoi32 left runtime too, and is in no
#     go1.26.9 package. (At 1.25.14 the same pair sat in internal/runtime/strconv, which go1.26.9 removed.)
#   AMENDED 2026-10-15 (H3 route 2, the i9): runtime -> internal/strconv is DROPPED; its row is removed below.
#     internal/strconv's TestAtoi uses strconv's parseInt32Tests/parseInt64Tests and the error-returning Atoi;
#     runtime's used atoi32tests/atoi64tests and runtime.Atoi's ok bool, tables that exist nowhere at go1.26.9.
#     The 0.84 was a shared switch/range/Errorf skeleton (exact-body ratio: runtime 0.43, strconv 0.64).
#     runtime's TestAtoi and TestAtoi32 are DELETED at 1.26. Four arcs remain.
# NOT relocations, though a name says so:
#   crypto/internal/hpke -> crypto/hpke (the RECON's name list): its one test, TestRFC9180Vectors, scores 0.17 at
#     best against crypto/hpke's tests, which are new; its vectors file is replaced, not moved (6 entries in the
#     old schema, 24 in the new). crypto/internal/hpke is a TRUE REMOVAL; crypto/hpke a new row.
#   internal/itoa -> internal/strconv (the RECON's name list): TestItoa 0.17 and TestUitoa 0.40 against their
#     namesakes; TestUitox has none. The best cross-name scores, 0.52 to 0.57 against unrelated strconv tests,
#     are short bodies matching short bodies. internal/itoa is a TRUE REMOVAL.
# No origin, so NOT relocations: crypto/fips140, crypto/hpke, crypto/internal/fips140/subtle,
# crypto/internal/fips140cache, crypto/internal/fips140only, internal/runtime/cgroup, internal/runtime/gc/scan,
# internal/trace/testtrace, internal/trace/tracev2, math/big/internal/asmgen, testing/cryptotest, testing/synctest.
# crypto/internal/fips140/mldsa's field tests resemble mlkem's (0.74 to 0.92), but mlkem keeps all of its own:
# a sibling copy, not a move. internal/syscall/unix is not new: its new fchmodat_test.go and
# kernel_version_ge_test.go are the first of its test files to survive the windows axis.
